instruction: Install certbot for Let's Encrypt with Nginx plugin
output: apt install -y certbot python3-certbot-nginx

instruction: Obtain a Let's Encrypt certificate with certbot
output: certbot --nginx -d example.com -d www.example.com --non-interactive --agree-tos -m admin@example.com

instruction: Obtain a wildcard Let's Encrypt certificate via DNS challenge
output: certbot certonly --manual --preferred-challenges dns -d '*.example.com' -d example.com --agree-tos -m admin@example.com

instruction: Renew all Let's Encrypt certificates
output: certbot renew --quiet --no-self-upgrade

instruction: Check when Let's Encrypt certs expire
output: certbot certificates

instruction: Revoke a Let's Encrypt certificate
output: certbot revoke --cert-path /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/cert.pem --reason cessationofoperation

instruction: Install and configure uWSGI for Python apps
output:
apt install -y uwsgi uwsgi-plugin-python3 && mkdir -p /etc/uwsgi/sites && echo -e '[uwsgi]
module = myapp:app
master = true
processes = 4
socket = /run/uwsgi/myapp.sock
chmod-socket = 660
vacuum = true
die-on-term = true' > /etc/uwsgi/sites/myapp.ini

instruction: Run uWSGI with Emperor mode for multi-app
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/uwsgi-emperor.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=uWSGI Emperor
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/uwsgi --emperor /etc/uwsgi/sites --uid www-data --gid www-data
Restart=always
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now uwsgi-emperor

instruction: Install and configure Gunicorn for Python apps
output: pip3 install gunicorn && gunicorn --workers 4 --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 myapp:app --daemon --pid /run/gunicorn.pid --log-file /var/log/gunicorn.log

instruction: Create a Gunicorn systemd service
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/gunicorn.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Gunicorn Python WSGI
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/gunicorn --workers 4 --bind unix:/run/gunicorn.sock myapp:app
Restart=always
User=www-data
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now gunicorn

instruction: Install Passenger for Nginx
output: apt install -y dirmngr gnupg && apt-key adv --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys 561F9B9CAC40B2F7 && sh -c 'echo deb https://oss-binaries.phusionpassenger.com/apt/passenger bookworm main > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/passenger.list' && apt update && apt install -y libnginx-mod-http-passenger

instruction: Create a custom ModSecurity rule to block SQLi
output: echo -e 'SecRule ARGS "\\b(?i)select\\b.*\\bfrom\\b" "id:10001,phase:2,deny,status:403,msg:"SQL Injection blocked""' > /etc/modsecurity/custom-rules.conf && sed -i 's|SecRuleEngine DetectionOnly|SecRuleEngine On|' /etc/modsecurity/modsecurity.conf && echo 'Include /etc/modsecurity/custom-rules.conf' >> /etc/modsecurity/modsecurity.conf && systemctl restart apache2

instruction: Set up ModSecurity audit log
output: echo -e 'SecAuditEngine RelevantOnly\nSecAuditLog /var/log/modsec_audit.log\nSecAuditLogParts ABIJDEFHZ' >> /etc/modsecurity/modsecurity.conf && systemctl restart apache2

instruction: Set up HAProxy stats page
output:
echo -e 'frontend stats
  bind *:8404
  stats enable
  stats uri /
  stats refresh 10s
  stats auth admin:password123' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Set up HAProxy with SPOE for WAF
output:
echo -e 'frontend http-in
  bind *:80
  filter spoe engine waf config /etc/haproxy/spoe-waf.conf
  http-request allow
  default_backend app' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Configure HAProxy to send logs via TCP
output:
echo -e 'global
  log 192.168.1.100:514 len 4096 local0

defaults
  log global
  option httplog' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg && systemctl restart haproxy

instruction: Set up Squid as a reverse proxy with caching
output:
echo -e 'http_port 80 accel vhost
cache_peer 127.0.0.1 parent 8080 0 no-query originserver
cache_dir ufs /var/spool/squid 100 16 256
request_header_access Via deny all
request_header_access X-Forwarded-For deny all' >> /etc/squid/squid.conf && systemctl restart squid

instruction: Configure Squid with access control lists
output:
echo -e 'acl work_hours time MTWHF 09:00-17:00
acl allowed_sites dstdomain .example.com
http_access allow work_hours allowed_sites
http_access deny all' >> /etc/squid/squid.conf && systemctl restart squid

instruction: Enable SSL inspection in Squid
output:
echo -e 'http_port 3128 ssl-bump cert=/etc/squid/ssl_cert/myCA.pem generate-host-certificates=on dynamic_cert_mem_cache_size=4MB
sslcrtd_program /usr/lib/squid/ssl_crtd -s /var/lib/ssl_db -M 4MB
ssl_bump peek all
ssl_bump bump all' >> /etc/squid/squid.conf && /usr/lib/squid/security_file_certgen -c -s /var/spool/squid/ssl_db -M 4MB && systemctl restart squid

instruction: Install and configure lighttpd with SSL
Enable mod_compress in lighttpd
output: lighty-enable-mod compress && echo -e 'compress.cache-dir = "/var/cache/lighttpd/compress/"\ncompress.filetype = ("text/html", "text/plain", "text/css", "application/javascript")' >> /etc/lighttpd/lighttpd.conf && systemctl restart lighttpd

instruction: Fetch a page with HTTP/2 using curl
output: curl --http2 -I https://example.com

instruction: Test HTTP/3 with curl
output: curl --http3 -I https://example.com

instruction: Download a file with progress bar using wget
output: wget --progress=bar:force https://example.com/largefile.zip

instruction: Use httpie for a POST request with JSON body
output: http POST https://api.example.com/users name=John email=john@example.com

instruction: Install and use hey for load testing
output: wget -q https://hey-release.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/hey_linux_amd64 -O /usr/local/bin/hey && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/hey && hey -z 10s -c 50 http://localhost:8080/api
